/bin/zsh -lc "ruby -e '
files=Dir[\"src/**/*.java\"]
files.each do |f|
  depth=0; stack=[]; buf=\"\"; block=false
  File.readlines(f).each_with_index do |raw,i|
    s=raw.dup
    if block
      if s.include?(\"*/\"); s=s.split(\"*/\",2)[1]||\"\"; block=false else; next end
    end
    while s.include?(\"/*\")
      a,b=s.split(\"/*\",2); if b.include?(\"*/\"); s=a+(b.split(\"*/\",2)[1]||\"\") else; s=a; block=true end
    end
    s=s.sub(%r{//.*},\"\")
    stripped=s.strip
    if stripped.include?(\"delegate(\") || stripped.match?(/\\bdelegate\\s*\\(/)
      decl = stripped.match?(/\\bdelegate\\s*\\(["'^;]*'"\\)\\s*(?:\\{|;|throws)/) && "'!stripped.match?(/(?:return|=|'"\\.)\\s+.*\\bdelegate\\s*\\(/)
      name = decl ? \"delegate\" : (stack.empty? ? \"?\" : stack[-1][1])
      puts \"#{f}:#{i+1}:#{name}:#{stripped}\"
    end
    opens=s.count(\"{\"); closes=s.count(\"}\")
    if opens>0
      hdr=(buf+\" \"+s.split(\"{\",2)[0]).gsub(/@[A-Za-z0-9_.]+(?:\\(["'^)]*'"\\))?/,\" \").gsub(/\\s+/,\" \")
      names=hdr.scan(/([A-Za-z_"'$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)'"\\s*\\(/).flatten
      n=names[-1]
      bad=%w[if for while switch catch synchronized return new throw]
      if n && "'!bad.include?(n) && !hdr.include?(" class ") && !hdr.include?(" interface ") && !hdr.include?(" enum ")
        stack << [depth+1,n]
      end
      buf=""
    elsif stripped.end_with?(";") || stripped.empty?
      buf=""
    else
      buf += " "+stripped unless stripped.start_with?("@")
    end
    depth += opens-closes
    stack.pop while !stack.empty? && depth < stack[-1][0]
  end
end
'"' > /tmp/delegate_methods.txt
wc -l /tmp/delegate_methods.txt
sed -n '1,80p' /tmp/delegate_methods.txt"
